title: Orbitlytics Standup - v2 Onboarding Beta Prep

transcript.speaker: Priya Nandakumar
transcript.text: Quick standup - beta launch for the v2 onboarding flow is Friday. Where do we stand?

transcript.speaker: Sofia Marchetti
transcript.text: Frontend's done except one thing - the progress bar jumps from 40% to 100% because we're missing an intermediate step for email verification. I'll add that step today.

transcript.speaker: Jae-won Lee
transcript.text: Backend's ready. Verification emails send within a couple seconds in my testing.

transcript.speaker: Tomasz Kowalski
transcript.text: I ran the full onboarding suite twice - both green. I did find one edge case: if someone closes the tab right after verifying their email but before the welcome screen loads, they get stuck in a weird half-onboarded state.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nandakumar
transcript.text: How common is that likely to be?

transcript.speaker: Tomasz Kowalski
transcript.text: Hard to say, but it's a real bug, not just a test artifact. I'd rate it medium severity.

transcript.speaker: Jae-won Lee
transcript.text: I can add a redirect check on login that finishes onboarding automatically if it detects that state. Give me until tomorrow morning.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nandakumar
transcript.text: Let's do that - I don't want to slip Friday over it, but let's not ship with a known dead-end either.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Marchetti
transcript.text: Sounds good, I'll retest once Jae-won's fix lands.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nandakumar
transcript.text: One open question for the group - do we soft-launch to 10% of new signups Friday, or go to everyone at once?

transcript.speaker: Tomasz Kowalski
transcript.text: I'd lean soft launch given we just found a new edge case this morning.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nandakumar
transcript.text: Fair. Let's decide tomorrow after Jae-won's fix is in and retested, not today.

summary_key_points: Frontend is adding a missing progress step for email verification
QA found a medium-severity bug where closing the tab after verification leaves users half-onboarded
A fix and retest are planned before Friday's beta launch

action_items.task: Add the missing progress bar step for email verification
Add a redirect check on login to auto-finish onboarding for stuck users
Retest onboarding once the redirect fix lands

decisions: Decide tomorrow, after the fix is retested, whether to soft-launch to 10% of signups or launch to everyone
open_questions: Should Friday's beta launch go to 10% of new signups or to everyone at once?
